cards.title: Decide Open Graph image fallback (blocked on artwork)
cards.note:
REMINDER — client asked to be reminded later. Owner: client. Package B4 in the SEO/GEO plan.

No Open Graph image exists anywhere. No app/opengraph-image.*, no `images` on `/` or `/products`, no fallback. Product pages only get an og:image when the record has a hero image; the other products have none (verified live: only `test-listing` carries an image). Every share of the homepage, the catalogue and almost every product is a bare text card.

Parked on one of:
(a) client supplies brand artwork at 1200x630 (preferred);
(b) explicit decision to ship a typographic fallback built from the existing logo;
(c) explicitly accept bare text cards and drop the item.

Generating brand artwork unasked is inventing design — do not do (b) without a yes.

Also blocks: `twitter: { card: "summary_large_image" }` in the root layout, since it depends on this asset.
